Every worked-example line ran as written, against fake copilot/claude/vloop scripts built from the tool's testdata/worked, and all matched the brief: o1 mean 1 with graders a-d at 1; o2 mean 0.6667 with b at 0 and NOTES b; o3 exit 1 'scaffold exited 3: boom'; o4 skipped 'no phase'; both --list lines; the unknown-agent and not-empty refusals; o6 gave the same trace as o1. The README's layout list omits the per-run <phase>-<n>.stderr file and the copilot-home and plugin directories under repo/.vloop/tmp. docs/design-notes/vloop-roadmap.md has no B33 row yet, which is presumably the operator's at close.
